newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen drifting lower, outlook bearish.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen drifting lower, outlook bearish.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures could extend this week's run of losses as technical prospects for London's benchmark September contract turn more bearish, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
September sank to a new four-month low on Tuesday in a second consecutive losing session, with fresh selling and fund long liquidation taking a toll on prices.

Technical analysts said the crucial bear signal came when the contract fell through and closed below support at 1,000 stg. Until this level was regained, they said, prospects for a recovery were slim.
"It's going to have to move aggressively above the 1,000 level, probably back above 1,020, to say it's actually a false downward break," said Susan Rigg, an analyst at Chart Analysis.
"Now it's broken that major support level it might drift a bit further down," she said. "But obviously a close back above 1,000 would be a sign that we're getting somewhere."
Traders called the market to open unchanged to two stg higher than Tuesday's close.
On the downside, initial support was pegged at 960 stg followed by the mid-February trough of 895 stg.
Rigg said although prices were relatively well supported down to 895 stg, the chart still looked patchy and resistance appeared to be stronger than support.
"The amount of supply that we've got overhead is more than the support we've got underneath," she said.
